propositions: Author guides currently read from config.repo_root()/docs/ which resolves to the consuming project's repo root, making guides inaccessible when rebar is installed as a library or CLI tool without docs/ directory.

Moving canonical copies of writing-a-passing-plan.md and passing-code-review.md into src/rebar/_guides/ and reading them via importlib.resources makes guides accessible from any rebar installation independent of repo root.
explain_criterion() must render sections from the packaged registry via _guide_section_body() rather than reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md to remove repo-root file-system dependency.

With guides packaged as resources and explain_guide()/explain_criterion() repo-root independent, rebar explain plan/review/<criterion-id> must exit 0 and return content when REBAR_ROOT contains no docs/ directory.
Thin pointer files in docs/ must remain so existing documentation links and cross-references do not break.
Both guides must be present and verifiable as packaged resources in the built wheel.
